name: Tunnel Vision
source:
Awakening in an empty room, paralysed from the waist down and accused of a crime they have no memory of committing, our protagonist Suoni V Linnet hopes to escape the dire situation they seem to be in when it soon becomes apparent they are not alone.

Faced with an eccentric mask-wearing entity, an overly enthusiastic child, and a curious cat, Linnet must tread carefully with each interaction.

But when Linnet can't even trust their own mind, what hope do they have of attaining freedom?

Help Linnet discover the truth, who they can trust, and perhaps even a little companionship along the way.

[Edited from [url=https://melancholy-marionette.itch.io/tunnel-vision]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
我们的主人公索尼·V·林内特 (Suoni V Linnet) 在一间空荡荡的房间里醒来，腰部以下瘫痪，并被指控犯有自己不记得的罪行，他希望摆脱他们似乎所处的可怕处境，但很快就发现他们并不孤单。

面对古怪的戴着面具的实体、过于热情的孩子和好奇的猫，林内特必须谨慎对待每一次互动。

但当林内特连自己的想法都无法相信时，他们还有什么希望获得自由呢？

帮助红雀发现真相、他们可以信任的人，甚至可能一路上有一点陪伴。

[编辑自[url=https://melancholy-marionette.itch.io/tunnel-vision]itch.io[/url]]
